title: Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program Return Terms
content:
| Tier | Return request window, calendar days from the carrier delivery date | Restocking fee withheld from the credit | Opened supplies returnable |
|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 30 | 15 percent | No |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 0 percent | No |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 30 | 0 percent | No |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 30 | 0 percent | No |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 30 | 0 percent | No |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 30 | 0 percent | No |

These are the return figures of the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program.

- The return window is the time for requesting the return of unopened, sealed items, counted in calendar days from the carrier delivery date of the shipment.
- The restocking fee is an integer percent of the amount the customer paid for the returned units, withheld from the credit for an accepted return.
- "Opened supplies returnable: No" means opened medical supplies may not be returned for credit on any tier.

**Q. Does the restocking percentage differ by tier?** Yes. Only the self-pay tier withholds a restocking fee (15 percent); every insured tier withholds 0 percent.

**Q. Is the window the same everywhere?** Yes, 30 calendar days on all six tiers.
